parsed.summary: The drawing implements the architecture the specification describes: two MCP2515 CAN controllers (U27/U6) each with a 16 MHz crystal (Y4/Y6, matching the corrected value the spec requires), isolated CAN transceivers (U22/U38) broken out on M12 connectors, the LTC4412xS6 + P-channel MOSFET ideal-diode USB path (U52/Q5), SN74LVC1G07 open-drain buffers wired as /OE-controlled e-stop/indicator sinks, SM712-class TVS protection, and the PCA9536/ISL54222 parts for power-switch and USB/serial routing. Remaining oddities (crossed-out jumpers, DNP parts, direct switch on GLOBAL_EN, unresolved LED polarity questions) correspond to documented open issues or assembly options, not deviations from intent, so no anomaly is reported.
